title: calanthe furcata f. fauriei
intro: Calanthe furcata f. fauriei, commonly known as the Korean orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Calanthe furcata f. fauriei include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
